displayName.zh: 极寒极点探险 (奥伊米亚康)

summary.en: Temperatures below -50°C (-58°F) are standard. At -60°C, exposed skin freezes in seconds. Your spit can freeze before hitting the ground. Metal sticks to skin instantly.
summary.zh: 低于 -50°C (-58°F) 的气温是常态。在 -60°C 时，裸露的皮肤几秒钟内就会冻结。吐出的口水落地前就会结冰。金属会瞬间粘在皮肤上。

mitigations.en: Do NOT wear metal frame glasses (they will freeze to your face). Use plastic or contacts.
mitigations.zh: 切勿佩戴金属框眼镜（会冻在脸上）。请使用塑料框或隐形眼镜。

mitigations.en: Cover face completely. Breathe through a scarf/mask to warm the air before it hits lungs.
mitigations.zh: 完全遮住面部。透过围巾/面罩呼吸，在空气进入肺部前将其加热。

summary.en: Cars must be kept running 24/7 or parked in heated garages. If an engine stops on the Kolyma Highway ('Road of Bones'), it may never restart, leading to fatal freezing.
summary.zh: 汽车必须 24/7 保持运转或停在加热的车库中。如果引擎在科雷马公路（"尸骨之路"）上熄火，可能永远无法重启，导致致命的冻结。

mitigations.en: Travel in a convoy (two cars minimum) for backup.
mitigations.zh: 结伴出行（至少两辆车）以备后援。

mitigations.en: Hire experienced local drivers who know how to fix frozen mechanics.
mitigations.zh: 雇佣有经验的当地司机，他们知道如何修理冻结的机械。

items.en: Valenki (Traditional felt boots) or Baffin -100°C rated boots. Regular hiking boots will fail.
items.zh: Valenki（传统毡靴）或 Baffin -100°C 评级靴子。普通登山靴会失效（鞋底冻裂）。

items.en: Fur (Real fur is standard here for a reason, synthetics often underperform).
items.zh: 皮草（真皮草在这里是标准配置是有原因的，合成材料往往表现不佳）。

items.en: Cash (Rubles) - Electronic payments fail due to cold or lack of signal.
items.zh: 现金（卢布）- 电子支付因寒冷或无信号而失效。

items.en: Visa & geopolitical check (Entry rules are strict and changeable).
items.zh: 签证与地缘政治检查（入境规则严格且多变）。

message.en: Visitors can get an official 'Pole of Cold' certificate from the Keeper of the Cold in Oymyakon, stating the temperature on the day of visit.
message.zh: 游客可以从奥伊米亚康的"寒冷守护者"那里获得官方的"极寒极点"证书，上面注明访问当天的气温。

title.en: Ask guide to arrange certificate ceremony
